description: Wind induced loads on hip roof overhangs of low rise building (Phase II) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Ioannis Zisis, Florida International University (fiu.edu). The Laboratory for Wind Engineering Research (LWER) of the Extreme Events Institute (EEI) at Florida International University (FIU) was commissioned by the Florida Building Commission / Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation to investigate the wind-induced loads on roof overhangs of low-rise residential buildings. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Roof Overhangs, Soffits, Wind Loads, Pressure Coefficient, Wind Tunnel, Wind Standards And Codes Of Practice. Published 2022-06-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
